criteria: Clearly states implication (not just a summary of the article)
Specific to this article (not reusable across articles in the same topic)
Adds information not already in the headline
Factually grounded — not hallucinated or unsupported by the article context
Concise: target 1-2 sentences; up to 3 acceptable; hard fail if more than 3 or obviously bloated
passFail.rule: ALL must pass for overall pass

catastrophicCriteria.note: Any catastrophic tag fires isCatastrophicFailure. Low score alone is not sufficient.

noMaterialTopicRegression.definition: Material regression = pass rate drop beyond 10 points, any new catastrophic failure, or human preference loss on gold-set items for a topic
